## `lakana deployments list`

Usage: `lakana deployments list [OPTIONS]`

Show the current project version per repository.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

## `lakana deployments set-run-as`

Usage: `lakana deployments set-run-as [OPTIONS] [repo]`

Bind (or with --clear remove) the service account REPO's runs write as.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REPO` | text | none | Repository name (default: lakana.yaml's repo:). |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--principal` | text | none | An active service account. |
| `--clear` | flag | off | Stop using a fixed identity for the runs. |
